Introduction

This documents out lines the equipment 
 inspection I1, which must be performed every six months as indicated by M6 at the 
 titled block.

The first draft initiated by eng. Mohamed Abdel 
Moneim, tested by eng. 
Yasser Abdo, accepted by electrical general director eng. Said Mahmoud Hessain Farag, 
 revised by EDEPC inspection & quality control engineer Adel Abdel Kader 
 El-Naggar & Saad Mahmoud 
 Bassuny, and approved by eng. Mokhtar Abdel 
Latif Mady; head sector of Ataka PS.

This 
document accepted by eng. Samir Abd El Gilil: EDEPC inspection & quality control 
general director, MPIS coordinator, and 
certified by accountant Mahmoud Soliman: EDEPC admin & financial inspection & 
quality control's general director and supervisor of inspection & quality 
control head sector

Safety
Precautions

A work permit must be issued, the qualified maintenance 
 staff must carry the suitable ID safety category.
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required.

Wear safety and health equipment as safety 
 helmet, safety shoes, safety belts ... etc.

items:
A work permit must be issued, the qualified maintenance 
 staff must carry the suitable ID safety category.
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required.
Isolate and ground the Bus bar completely.
Check by the HV tester rod.

sections.text: Tools and Equipment
Work to be Carried Out
Draw circuit breakers out of Bus Bar.
Dismantle upper and lower shutters.

Blow the dust and dirt out of Bus Bar (using vacuum 
cleaner)

Clean the upper contactors (related to Bus Bar) and 
lower contactors (related to cables)

Check current transformers to be well fixed, retighten 
bolts and screws and clean it.

Retighten bolts and screws at links between Bus Bar 
parts and at links between Bus Bar and contactors, also at links between cable 
ends and contactors

Check and clean potential transformer and its cell, 
also check and fix its capsules (cartridges), check and clean arresters

Check the heaters in the cells to be switched on, 
clean it, put the indicator of each heater at the suitable position

Check automatic fire fighting with sensible pipes, 
check the pipes to be far from cable ends put it away from any sharp edges, 
check the extinguisher cylinders to be in good condition

Check earthing switch of each feeder cell to be in 
good contact (as it switched on), check also that it moves is easily

Check cells to be well sealed and no way for rats to 
get into the cells

Clean the upper parts of cells and the instruments 
involved in it such as protection apparatus, timers, measuring instruments, etc, 
using video cleaner

Clean shutters well and put it in its places in the 
cells.

Clean the passages that tracks across it in and out 
the cells, so breakers could get in and out of cells easily.
Switch off earthing switches for all feeders cells.

Put breakers in test position, switch on and off the 
breakers electrically, and then put them into their cells.

items:
Switched off the transformer which feeds the Bus Bar, and 
 isolate the Bus Bar 
 from the two sides by switching off the two bus ties at the 
 two sides.
Switch off all feeders at the Bus Bar and switch on their earthing switches.

Insure that all 3 phases of each 
feeder at that busbar don't pass a current through it before draw the circuit 
breaker's out of the busbsar.

ends and contactors

also check and fix its capsules (cartridges), check and clean arresters

Check the heaters in the cells to be switched on, 
clean it, put the indicator of each heater at the suitable position

Check automatic fire fighting with sensible pipes, 
check the pipes to be far from cable ends put it away from any sharp edges, 
check the extinguisher cylinders to be in good condition

Check earthing switch of each feeder cell to be in 
good contact (as it switched on), check also that it moves is easily

Check cells to be well sealed and no way for rats to 
get into the cells

Clean the upper parts of cells and the instruments 
involved in it such as protection apparatus, timers, measuring instruments, etc, 
using video cleaner

Clean shutters well and put it in its places in the 
cells.

Clean the passages that tracks across it in and out 
the cells, so breakers could get in and out of cells easily.
Switch off earthing switches for all feeders cells.

Put breakers in test position, switch on and off the 
breakers electrically, and then put them into their cells.
